value.body: A BBA track focused on making the business run — operations management, supply chain and logistics, procurement and inventory, quality management (lean, Six Sigma), project management and basic operations research.

items.label: Regulator
items.note: Alongside the affiliating university; BBA, BCA and BMS were brought under AICTE from 2024-25

value.title: How you get in
value.body: Class 12 in any stream. Admission is by Class 12 marks, CUET-UG, or a university's own test. Most students pick the specialisation in the second or third year; some institutes admit directly to a named programme.

value.title: At a glance
items: Work is close to the ground — warehouses, plants, e-commerce fulfilment and procurement desks — and can involve shifts or site postings.
Entry roles include operations executive, supply-chain or logistics coordinator, and procurement or inventory analyst.
Spreadsheet and ERP skills (for example SAP) are commonly expected.
Common next steps: an MBA (Operations or Supply Chain), or certifications such as Six Sigma.
